title: [Request] Add a new reasoning button.
body:
### 🥰 Feature Description

Problem:
- NVIDIA NIM has a new model named 'Deepseek V3.1'. 
- The problem is, is NVIDIA didn't separate it with reasoning and chat.
- Now whenever using the model, it does not use the reasoning. Only the chat.

### 🧐 Proposed Solution

Add a reasoning button. Request reasoning button.

### 📝 Additional Information

_No response_

## Summary by Sourcery

Enhance NVIDIA NIM chat support by adding DeepSeek V3.1 model and unifying thinking-mode handling across providers

New Features:
- Add DeepSeek V3.1 chat model with extended context window and reasoning capability

Enhancements:
- Introduce THINKING_MODELS constant and inject chat_template_kwargs for thinking flag in NVIDIA and AkashChat runtimes
- Remove redundant enabled flags from existing NVIDIA chat model definitions
- Eliminate explicit stream parameter in AkashChat provider and tighten thinking-model matching to exact IDs
